summary: The live gates pass and the headline numbers reconcile. The pilot report contains a wrong file count and does not present reliable gate, mutation, or finding evidence.

evidence: The phase base is e91c4d4cc3c8d5d61a1e9b802c031247543180fa. The acceptance role base and audited HEAD are both 24733e3b0cc63ae533501cfaf4f4998c96aafe4e.

Review B, Review C, UX browser review, and adversarial testing do not apply to Phase 4 under test-strategy.md:67–69 and :277–279. No browser ran.
All five Phase 4 tasks carry [x] and a first-line SHA for an actual report commit. The report is absent at the phase base and nonempty at the audited HEAD.

At the audited HEAD, fresh heavy-run coverage passed 1,412 tests in 98 files and measured 92.07% lines (1,674 of 1,818). Type checking produced no diagnostics. Lint had zero errors and three existing warnings.

A5: The recorded Phase 4 Green log shows 1,412 passing tests, and the fresh commands pass. Passing commands do not validate the report assertions in F31–F35. A3, A4, A6, and A7 do not apply to the unchanged Measure framework.
I opened and compared baseline.json, nine class and merge receipts, the final receipt, the time logs and JSON, and the cited proof and review artifacts.
The baseline is 3,175 cases and 86.52% lines. The final result is 1,412 cases and 92.07% lines. The 1,763-case cut is 55.53%, and coverage rises 5.55 points.
The blog merge removes 1,709 cases and passes the named breakage condition in proof-blog-merge.log. Before the merge, the cut was 81 cases. Without the merge, the final cut would be 54 cases.
The nine class and merge receipt values match the numerical cells in report.md:22–31. The D3 row correctly has no test gate. The D5 part 2 cited Green path does not prove its result.

The 77 K groups match classification.md by path and count. They sum to 2,843. The current table has 67 none labels and 10 proof labels. Those counts do not establish that the proofs match the K rules.
The baseline GREEN duration is 90.47 s. The final historical GREEN duration is 98.11 s. The increase is 7.64 s. The report correctly separates the unknown cause from the hypothesis.
I recomputed the five head assertion-time sums in order: 6461.93, 1649.38, 1303.32, 970.85, and 859.77 ms. All five match. The timing JSON has no root duration.

F27 added a status column, but F33 shows that some row statuses are wrong. F28 and F29 fix the unknown-cause and timing schema text. F30 correctly reports 36 of 37 historical role JSONs with both fields.
The Phase 2 acceptance artifact records its F1–F3 as closed. The pilot report does not accurately identify all of them. ADV-4 and ADV-5 also reuse IDs for scope notes in adversarial-d30e5a2.json.
The report contains the lessons and open items sections. The PM approved option A for F18 on 2026-11-24. Closeout updates report.md:198 and :234. The timing increase and hypothesis are report-only.
